product.title: Gauntlet L3: Economic Policy Simulator
product.summary: Eight quarters of fiscal, monetary and trade policy for a city in crisis.
product.whatStudentsDo: Students advise a city whose largest factory has closed, choosing fiscal, monetary and trade policy each quarter across two in-game years and balancing unemployment, inflation, growth and public approval. Policies take effect on a delay, and the engine models the trade-off between unemployment and inflation directly.

studentDataProfile.notes: State kept in browser localStorage only; no server call observed.

governance.maturityBasis: The deepest macroeconomics in the whole portfolio, complete and reachable, though evidence collection is manual. No student-run evidence exists.

health.technicalBasis: Reachable via the Gauntlet landing page on 2026-08-14. Reachability only.

governance.notes: The only simulation in the account with substantial macroeconomics coverage — fiscal policy, monetary policy, inflation, the business cycle and the multiplier all appear here and almost nowhere else.

provenance.evidence: GAUNTLET/gauntlet-l3/index.html: 'You are the Chief Economic Advisor... largest factory just closed, laying off 2,000 workers', with an explicit Phillips-curve relationship in the engine and a manual claim code submitted through a separate BOW form.
